Because the air is heavy with moisture.
Therefore, there will be rain this afternoon.
Uh... it's that simple?

m.x: What is it?
May I invite you to be my guest at Amekiku, my ==SEX11==?
Amekiku... Sounds familiar.
Where's that again?
It is a way station I restored for the convenience of Trekkers.
Oh, right!
I remember now!
It is quite all right, my ==SEX11==.
Scarcely any Trekkers visit Amekiku.
Really? Is that so?
Then I'll be your first guest to get the full experience!
Of course, my ==SEX11==.
I shall await your arrival.
My ==SEX11==, do you require an escort at this time?
Nope, I'm good!
I understand.
In that case, will you require an escort later, my ==SEX11==?
Don't think so...
Chitose, you can take a break.
You don't have to be on guard 24/7.
Very well.
Then, will you require an escort tomorrow, my ==SEX11==?
Never mind.
You can just come over now, Chitose.
My ==SEX11==, have you had a sudden need for an escort?
Not really.
But we could go for a walk and clear our heads.
My ==SEX11==, I believe the time has come.
The time for what?
What is it time for?
The time for you to become my Wielder.
Whoa, that's sudden!
I have brought a whetstone and blade oil.
Yes, my ==SEX11==. That is one way to interpret it.
This is a pretty big deal...
Is my training still insufficient?
No no no!
If anything, my training isn't up to par.
But if you insist...
I can be your Interim Wielder.
Interim Wielder?
We train together until we can truly trust each other with our convictions.
Only then will I become your true Wielder.
Then I shall endeavor to do so alongside you, my ==SEX11==.
My ==SEX11==, are you available today?
Perfect timing, I was just looking for you.
Do you remember that today is your birthday?
I do, but I have not celebrated it for quite some time.
Well, that's about to change. Come on over.
We have a birthday surprise for you.
Truly, there is no need for such a fuss.
No no no!
We insist.
A fine blade deserves a fine sheath!
My ==SEX11==, you are truly considerate.
Hurry!
We got you a cake shaped like an onigiri.
Please wait a moment, my ==SEX11==. I am on my way.
My ==SEX11==, I believe I have reached an impasse in my swordsmanship.
What seems to be the problem?
I'm guessing it isn't an issue with your form.
You are correct, my ==SEX11==. The problem lies within my heart.
Your heart?
When I raise my sword, I find myself unable to achieve a tranquil mind.
The moment my blade falls, memories of the past flood my thoughts.
Maybe you shouldn't worry about it so much.
It's normal for your mind to race when you swing a blade.
You're not an unfeeling fighting machine, after all.
Is this a good thing?
Yes. Only by thinking carefully and grasping the reason you raise your sword
can you strike a blow free from all distraction.
Reaching that state takes time. It's a journey.
I will take my time to comprehend this.
My ==SEX11==, it is raining again.
Yeah, one storm after another.
I wonder when it'll finally clear up.
In Goodwind, there is a sword technique that involves multiple slashes.
The blade is swung so swiftly it can shatter each falling raindrop.
Ohhh, I've seen you use that move!
But it is not yet perfected.
I possess three blades, yet my strength is not threefold.
You're already incredible, though.
The journey of tempering one's blade is a long one.
My ==SEX11==, would you be willing to witness as I walk this path?
It would be my honor.
No matter how long or winding the road is, I'll be with you the whole way!
I had an exceptionally salty stew today.
What happened?
My hand slipped, added too much salt.
One should add water when it's too salty, and add salt when the taste becomes too bland...
Sadly, the pot was nearly filled to the brim.
The heart of the problem was that I was thrown off balance.
Halfway through making the stew, someone came knocking at the door.
Who was it?
That courier who rides a bicycle.
She said there was an urgent express delivery, therefore I signed for it.
Then I went back inside and resumed cooking.
Just as I was about to add the salt, another urgent delivery arrived. I was startled and accidentally poured in a whole spoonful.
In the end, I moved the stove and the pot right to the doorway. Just in case...
My ==SEX11==, there was a mud rain here yesterday.
Mud rain? What's that?
Dust gets swept into the sky by the wind; and if it happens to rain at the same time, it turns into mud rain.
When it falls on clothes, it leaves muddy spots.
For those who have laundry drying outside, it's a grave disaster.
What a scary thought
Fortunately, I sensed the coming of mud rain and brought the laundry in beforehand.
I even warned a passerby to hurry home and take in her clothes; alas, she did not believe me.
She said, "If it's going to rain mud, why are you standing out here without an umbrella?"
She even thought I was trying to sell her some kind of laundry Artifact.
I debated with her point by point, and in the end she got annoyed and walked away.
What I don't understand is this... Disagreeing with her doesn't mean I dislike her.
Why was she so incensed?
... I think most people have trouble distinguishing between the two...
My ==SEX11==, I recently attended a fireworks festival.
Wow!
How was it?
It was very beautiful.
When I was young, I saw fireworks from my family's courtyard, but only from afar.
This time I was there in person and had to look up to watch.
The fireworks shot upward, drawing bright lines across the night sky, then suddenly exploded with thunderous sounds.
They burst into shapes I had never seen before. For a brief moment, the flashes even lit up the Monolith in the background.
I felt like I could never have enough of such splendor.
My ==SEX11==, do you think people could see those fireworks from Matsukawa?
When people in different places watch those same fireworks, what kind of things would be on their minds?
And those old acquaintances I haven't seen in a long time... Might they also be looking at the same sight?
Uh...
Matsukawa is probably too far away... You probably need to be in the same city to see it...
My ==SEX11==, it's been a long time. How have you been lately?
I'm doing well. How about you, Chitose?
I'm still learning how to cope with people.
I've never been good at understanding how things work, so I often end up in awkward situations and even get taken in by sly people.
It's a dangerous world out there. You must be careful, Chitose!
Indeed. My ==SEX11== is learned and well-traveled, so you surely don't have such troubles.
As for me, my clumsiness in handling social relationships leaves me exhausted, sometimes even on the verge of tears.
Social skills really do take a lot of practice...
If only human relationships were as simple as the crossing of blades...
... I suggest you reconsider...
My ==SEX11==, I'm still thinking about the social skills you mentioned last time.
Any new insights?
Some insights, yes, but also new worries.
When others show me kindness, I can never accept it without unease, and I certainly don't dare ask for it myself.
I know such kindness does not come with a price tag, yet I find myself constantly trying to calculate how to repay them.
Is this truly in line with what people call favor? Or is the sincerity of intention the only thing that matters?
You definitely need reciprocity, but it's not a math calculation...
Especially with friends, when you count every little thing, it starts to feel, well, not very friendly at all...
Sigh. The human relationship really is very complicated.
But one thing I'm sure of is this: Relationships are like knots, growing tighter with each exchange.
Sometimes all it takes is tying a knot to hold a bond firmly in place.
My ==SEX11==, I recently learned to make a new dish
Yeah?
Braised potatoes with meat.
First, cut the potatoes into chunks, slice the onions along the grain, and slice the meat as well.
Heat the pan and sauté the onions until golden. Then add oil, put in the meat, and stir-fry until it changes color.
Next, add sugar and soy sauce, then the potatoes, and finally enough water to cover everything. Let it simmer for half an hour.
Add seasoning right before serving, and it's done.
Now I'm hungry...
If your schedule allows, my ==SEX11==, would you come by Amekiku for a visit?
Let me prepare dinner for you.
Okay! I'm on my way!
Noted, I've already prepared tea and snacks. I am waiting in anxious anticipation.
